'''{{PAGENAME}}''' {{Lang|zh=椋羽}} is a NPC merchant with a [[Jade Steed]] found in [[Xuanfang Hold]], [[Mengzhou]] region. 

==Quests and Events==
{{Quests and Events}}

{{Dialogue Start}}
==Idle==
:'''Xiran:''' Step right up! Come take a look... Top-quality goods—
:'''Xiran:''' Taste... Big portions... Sweet as can be...
:'''Xiran:''' Ugh, when is this road gonna come back...

==Dialogue==
:'''Xiran:''' Step right up! Come take a look... Top-quality goods—

:'''Xiran:''' Taste... Big portions... Sweet as can be...

:'''Xiran:''' Ugh, when is this road gonna come back...

:The moment she notices you've stopped to look, the pained expression on her face vanishes. She forces a tight, strained smile.

:'''Xiran:''' ...Ah, hello, there. Interested in some mountain produce?

:'''Xiran:''' See this big and plump Uncracked Jade? The perfect ingredient for Little Snowy Moons. It'll make it sweet to the bone...

:'''Xiran:''' And these White Jade Beauties... I guarantee there's not a single bump or scratch. Absolutely flawless...

:'''Xiran:''' ...

:'''Xiran:''' Ugh... Sorry, I'm not in the mood at the moment... Come back some other time...
{{Dialogue End}}
